summary: Cabaletta Bio filed an 8-K (Item 8.01) solely to announce the posting of an updated corporate presentation on its website. No special-situation event—acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change—is disclosed. The filing references a routine investor materials update, not a material definitive agreement or event triggering a special-situations category. Accordingly, this is classified as None.
